content.json:
# Northstar Security Operations Dashboard
Microsoft Sentinel monitoring dashboard for Project 3 - Azure Threat Detection and Automated Incident Response.

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where CategoryValue == 'Administrative'
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ 'Success'
| where OperationNameValue in~ ('MICROSOFT.AUTHORIZATION/ROLEASSIGNMENTS/WRITE','MICROSOFT.AUTHORIZATION/ROLEASSIGNMENTS/DELETE','MICROSOFT.SECURITYINSIGHTS/ALERTRULES/WRITE','MICROSOFT.SECURITYINSIGHTS/ALERTRULES/DELETE')
| extend ChangeType = case(OperationNameValue =~ 'MICROSOFT.AUTHORIZATION/ROLEASSIGNMENTS/WRITE','RBAC Role Assignment Created or Updated',OperationNameValue =~ 'MICROSOFT.AUTHORIZATION/ROLEASSIGNMENTS/DELETE','RBAC Role Assignment Deleted',OperationNameValue =~ 'MICROSOFT.SECURITYINSIGHTS/ALERTRULES/WRITE','Sentinel Analytics Rule Created or Updated',OperationNameValue =~ 'MICROSOFT.SECURITYINSIGHTS/ALERTRULES/DELETE','Sentinel Analytics Rule Deleted','Other')
| project TimeGenerated, ChangeType, ResourceGroup
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Azure Security-Control Changes - Last 24 Hours

content.query:
AZKVAuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where OperationName in~ ('SecretSet','SecretGet')
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, ResultType, HttpStatusCode, IsRbacAuthorized
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Key Vault Secret Operations - Last 24 Hours

content.query:
_GetWatchlist('critical-assets')
| project AssetName, AssetType, Criticality, Purpose, ResourceGroup
| order by AssetType asc
content.title: Northstar Critical Assets Watchlist

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where CategoryValue == 'Administrative'
| summarize SecurityChanges=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Administrative Activity Over Time
